1. Mr. Deepak Joshi, learned counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel for the 
respondents. 
3. One of the contentions of learned counsel for the 
petitioner is that the Rules, which were applicable at the 
time of admission, did not debar a candidate to pursue his 
3rd semester, even if he had failed twice in various courses 
of the previous semesters. However, the relevant Rules 
applicable at the relevant time have not been annexed. 
4. Learned counsel for the respondent-University is 
granted a week’s time to place on record the Rules 
applicable at the time the petitioner was admitted to the 
course, and to also explain how the University justifies the 
Office Order dated 31.01.2026. 
5. List after a week. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
